title: Create .npmignore
description: Create .npmignore to exclude development files, source files (except templates), test files, and project-specific directories from the published npm package.
acceptanceCriteria: src/ directory is excluded (except src/templates/ which is allowed by 'files' field)
npm pack --dry-run does not include .test.ts files or .agent/ directory

steps.details: Create .npmignore with: .agent/ .github/ coverage/ docs/ *.test.ts tsconfig*.json eslint.config.js vitest.config.ts .prettierrc .prettierignore
Run `npm pack --dry-run` and confirm no .test.ts files or .agent/ directory appear in the file list.

technicalNotes: Note: when both 'files' field and .npmignore exist, 'files' takes precedence for inclusion. .npmignore is used to exclude files within included directories.
The src/templates/ directory is included via 'files' field even though src/ might be in .npmignore
